patches.from: 割当てミス分の人手対応を本来の4分/件ではなく未自動割当てと同じ2分/件で数えるなど、人手対応時間を過少に見積もると導入後合計が約300分となり、削減率は85%になる。割当てミスは4分/件で計上すべきで、過少評価による誤り。
patches.to: 自動割当てができなかった10%と割当てミスの5%を単純に足して人手対応が必要な割合を15%とみなし、残り85%がそのまま削減できたと考えた値。これは、割当てミスを全1,000件に対する5%＝50件とし、しかも人手対応を一律2分/件で数えたこと（（50＋100）×2＝300分、（2,000－300）÷2,000＝85%）に等しい。実際には割当てミスは自動割当てができた900件の5%＝45件で4分/件かかるため、導入後合計は45×4＋100×2＝380分、削減率は81%となり、この計算は誤り。
patches.target_note: jp-error: 旧経路 (2分/件) は 290 分→86% でウにならない。85% に至る経路 (100−10−5、=(50+100)×2=300 分) に差し替え

patches.from: 如果把分配错误部分的人工处理时间按本应的4分钟/件，而误按与未自动分配相同的2分钟/件来计算等，将人工处理时间低估，则引入后合计约为300分钟，削减率变为85%。分配错误应按4分钟/件计入，这是因低估而产生的错误。
patches.to: 把自动分配未成功的10%与分配错误的5%简单相加，视为需要人工处理的比例为15%，认为剩下的85%可以直接削减所得的值。这相当于把分配错误当作全部1,000件的5%＝50件，并且把人工处理一律按2分钟/件计算（（50＋100）×2＝300分钟，（2,000－300）÷2,000＝85%）。实际上分配错误是自动分配成功的900件的5%＝45件，每件需4分钟，因此引入后合计为45×4＋100×2＝380分钟，削减率为81%，这种算法是错误的。
patches.target_note: jp-error 是正に追従

patches.from: If the manual handling for incorrect assignments is counted at 2 min/case (the same as the non-auto-assigned cases) instead of the proper 4 min/case, underestimating the manual handling time, the total after introduction becomes about 300 min and the reduction rate becomes 85%. Incorrect assignments should be counted at 4 min/case, so this is an error caused by underestimation.
patches.to: This value comes from simply adding the 10% that could not be auto-assigned and the 5% of incorrect assignments, treating 15% as the share needing manual handling, and assuming the remaining 85% was saved outright. This is equivalent to taking the incorrect assignments as 5% of all 1,000 cases = 50 cases and also counting all manual handling at 2 min/case ((50 + 100) × 2 = 300 min, (2,000 − 300) ÷ 2,000 = 85%). In fact, the incorrect assignments are 5% of the 900 auto-assigned cases = 45 cases at 4 min/case, so the total after introduction is 45×4 + 100×2 = 380 min and the reduction rate is 81%; this calculation is wrong.
patches.target_note: jp-error 是正に追従

patches.from: 正确答案是ア「a-沿用现有的，b-沿用现有的」。本题问的是：在不停止系统、新旧并用地进行迁移（并行迁移）时，应该如何处理识别代码。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い冒頭の答え・設問要約を削除)

patches.from: 第一，题目已经确定：管理借阅履历的文件（表）直接沿用现有系统的。借阅履历的记录，是用书籍的识别号和借阅者卡的借阅者号来指明「借的是哪本书」「借书的是哪位借阅者」的。
patches.to: 第一是「管理借阅履历的文件（表）直接沿用现有系统的」，第二是「迁移期间条形码与RFID并用」。借阅履历表是用书籍的识别号和借阅者号来记录哪本书由谁借阅的。如果继续直接沿用这张表，那么存放在其中的键，即a的书籍识别号和b的借阅者号，都不能改变现有的号码体系。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp: 2 前提を冒頭で列挙、「キーの番号体系を変えてはいけない」を補充)

patches.from: 如果配合迁移把号码重新编成新的体系，那么已经积累的履历记录中的号码，与今后要追加的记录中的号码就成了两套不同的东西，混在同一张表里就无法追踪同一本书、同一位借阅者。虽然也可以做一张新旧号码的对照表、把过去的数据批量转换，但那样就偏离了「直接沿用现有文件」这一前提，还会招致转换出错和业务停摆的风险。
patches.to: 如果重新编成新的号码，过去借阅履历数据中的号码就会与新记录的号码对不上，需要重建表或借助号码对照表进行转换，「不停止业务、平稳迁移」这一目标就会落空。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 5 文に合わせる)

patches.from: 第二，迁移期间要把现在的条形码与新引入的RFID并用。给数十万册书粘贴RFID不可能一次做完，因此贴好RFID的书与还只有条形码的书会长期混在一起。为了无论用哪种介质读取都能识别为同一本书，把写入RFID的识别号设为与该书条形码所表示的现有识别号相同，是自然的做法。借阅者号也一样：即使换成内置RFID的新借阅者卡，只要借阅者号仍沿用现有的，旧卡的借阅者与新卡的借阅者在履历上就能作为同一个人连接起来，也就不必在意更换的先后顺序，业务可以照常进行。
patches.to: 此外，在给数十万册书全部贴完RFID之前，条形码与RFID会混在一起，因此必须让同一本书处于「无论用条形码读取还是用RFID读取都是同一个识别号」的状态，从这一点看也需要继续沿用现有号码。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 6 文に合わせる、借阅者号の段は jp に無い)

patches.from: 另外，号码保持不变的话，书架上的标签、对借阅者的通知、与其他系统的对接也都无需修改，可以把迁移成本与混乱降到最低。因此a和b都应沿用现有的，ア是正确的。
patches.to: 因此a和b都是「沿用现有的」，ア是正确答案。另外，作为附带的好处，保持现有号码的话，书架上的标签、对借阅者的通知、与其他系统的对接也都无需修改，但这只是补充，判断的依据始终是上述两个前提。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (「付随的な利点は補足で根拠は 2 前提」の切り分けを補充、jp の順序)

patches.from: The correct answer is ア: “a-Use the current one, b-Use the current one.” This question asks how identification codes should be handled when migrating without stopping the system, using the old and new methods together (parallel migration).
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い冒頭の答え・設問要約を削除)

patches.from: First, it has been decided that the file (table) for managing the lending history will continue to use the one from the current system as-is. Each lending history record points to which book was borrowed and which user borrowed it by means of the book identification number and the user number on the user card.
patches.to: First, “the file (table) for managing the lending history will continue to use the one from the current system as-is”; second, “barcodes and RFID are used together during the migration period.” The lending history table records which book was borrowed by whom using the book identification number and the user number. If this table is to keep being used as-is, the keys stored in it, namely both the book identification number in a and the user number in b, must not change from the current numbering scheme.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp: 2 前提を冒頭で列挙、「キーの番号体系を変えてはいけない」を補充)

patches.from: If the numbers were renumbered into a new scheme along with the migration, the numbers in the history records already accumulated and the numbers in the records to be added from now on would become different things, and once mixed in the same table it would no longer be possible to trace the same book or the same user. One could also create a mapping table between old and new numbers and convert all past data at once, but that departs from the premise of using the current file as-is, and it invites the risk of conversion errors and of operations coming to a halt.
patches.to: If the numbers were reassigned, the numbers in the past lending history data would no longer match those in new records, the table would have to be rebuilt or converted using a mapping table of numbers, and the aim of “migrating smoothly without halting operations” would collapse.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 5 文に合わせる)

patches.from: Second, during the migration period the current barcodes and the newly introduced RFID are used together. Attaching RFID to several hundred thousand books cannot be finished all at once, so books that already have RFID and books that still have only a barcode will be mixed together for a long time. To make sure the same book is recognized no matter which medium is read, it is natural to make the identification number written into the RFID the same as the current identification number that the book’s barcode represents. The same applies to the user number: even when switching to new user cards with built-in RFID, if the user number is carried over unchanged, the user of an old card and the user of a new card are linked as the same person in the history, so operations can continue without worrying about the order in which cards are replaced.
patches.to: Also, until RFID has been attached to all several hundred thousand books, barcodes and RFID will be mixed, so the same book must be kept in a state where “it has the same identification number whether read by barcode or by RFID”; on this point too, the current numbers must be continued.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 6 文に合わせる、利用者番号の段は jp に無い)

patches.from: In addition, if the numbers are left unchanged, the labels on the shelves, the notices to users, and the links with other systems also need no modification, which keeps migration cost and confusion to a minimum. Therefore both a and b should use the current ones, and ア is correct.
patches.to: Therefore both a and b are “use the current one,” and ア is correct. As an incidental benefit, keeping the current numbers also means that the labels on the shelves, the notices to users, and the links with other systems need not change, but this is supplementary; the basis for the judgment is strictly the two premises above.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (「付随的な利点は補足で根拠は 2 前提」の切り分けを補充、jp の順序)

patches.from: a沿用现有的是对的，但b把借阅者号换成新的号码这一点是错的。
patches.to: 这是只把b的借阅者号换成新号码的方案。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: 「直接沿用现有文件」这一前提随之崩塌，跨越迁移期间的业务——比如在借图书的归还处理、逾期与预约的管理——都会出问题。
patches.to: 这违背了「直接沿用现有文件」这一前提。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「前提に反します」、jp に無い業務例を削除)

patches.from: 而且在新号码的卡发到全体借阅者手中之前，旧卡和新卡都必须能受理，从这一点看，更换号码也是不利的。
patches.to: 即使把借阅者卡换成内置RFID的新卡，卡上记录的借阅者号本身也应沿用现有的，这才是正确的做法。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (イ「利用者番号は現行を引き継ぐのが正しい進め方」に差し戻し)

patches.from: Using the current one for a is correct, but replacing the user number with a new number for b is wrong.
patches.to: This option replaces only the user number in b with a new number.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: The premise of using the current file as-is collapses, and operations that span the migration period — such as processing the return of books that are out on loan, or managing overdue items and reservations — break down.
patches.to: This goes against the premise of using the current file as-is.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「前提に反します」、jp に無い業務例を削除)

patches.from: Also, until cards with new numbers have reached every user, both old and new cards must be accepted, and on that point too, switching the numbers is disadvantageous.
patches.to: Even when user cards are switched to new cards with built-in RFID, the correct approach is to carry over the current user number itself as the number recorded on the card.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (イ「利用者番号は現行を引き継ぐのが正しい進め方」に差し戻し)

patches.from: b沿用现有的是对的，但a把书籍的识别号换成新的号码这一点是错的。
patches.to: 这是只把a的书籍识别号换成新号码的方案。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: 每次借出、归还都得在意究竟是用哪个号码处理的。
patches.to: 借出、归还业务就会陷入混乱。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「貸出・返却業務が混乱します」)

patches.from: 给数十万册书全部重新编号这项作业本身，也伴随着标签的重贴与数据转换，与不停止业务完成迁移这一目标正面冲突。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い重貼りの論点を削除)

patches.from: Using the current one for b is correct, but replacing the book identification number with a new number for a is wrong.
patches.to: This option replaces only the book identification number in a with a new number.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: , and at every loan and return one would have to worry about which number the transaction was processed with.
patches.to: , throwing lending and return operations into confusion.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「貸出・返却業務が混乱します」)

patches.from: The work of renumbering all several hundred thousand books itself involves re-labeling and data conversion, which runs directly counter to the aim of migrating without halting operations.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い重貼りの論点を削除)

patches.from: 这是把a和b两者都换成新号码的做法，最不恰当。
patches.to: 这是把a和b两者都换成新号码的方案，是离前提最远的选择。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「前提から最も遠い選択」)

patches.from: 再考虑到迁移期间条形码与RFID、旧卡与新卡是混在一起的，就必须常态性地维持一套新旧号码对应管理的多余机制，非但不能不停业务地平稳迁移，反而会让迁移作业及其后的运行大幅复杂化。
patches.to: 这样就需要迁移全部数据并转换号码；而且数十万册藏书和全部借阅者卡都要一齐切换，无法满足「不停止业务、平稳迁移」这一条件。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 2 文後半・第 3 文に合わせる)

patches.from: This replaces both a and b with new numbers, and is the least appropriate.
patches.to: This replaces both a and b with new numbers, and is the choice furthest from the premises.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「前提から最も遠い選択」)

patches.from: Considering also that barcodes and RFID, and old and new cards, are mixed together during the migration period, an extra mechanism for constantly managing the correspondence between old and new numbers becomes permanently necessary. Far from migrating smoothly without halting operations, this would greatly complicate both the migration work and the operation that follows.
patches.to: All the data would then have to be transferred and the numbers converted, and the several hundred thousand books and all user cards would have to be switched over at once, so the condition of “migrating smoothly without halting operations” cannot be met.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 2 文後半・第 3 文に合わせる)

patches.from: 在系统迁移中，当要继承既有的数据或文件（表）时，作为引用这些数据之键的识别代码（书籍的识别号、借阅者号等）原则上要维持现有的。
patches.to: 如果迁移后仍直接使用既有的文件（表），那么作为其键的号码体系（书籍的识别号、借阅者号）就不要变更。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: 数据迁移与转换的工作量、风险和成本都会暴涨。在设计迁移方式时，把要变的东西（这里是读取介质）与不变的东西（这里是号码体系）区分开来考虑，是关键所在。
patches.to: 迁移的成本和风险都会暴涨。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「移行コストとリスクが跳ね上がる」、変わるもの/変わらないもの を削除)

patches.from: In a system migration, when existing data or files (tables) are carried over, the identification codes that serve as the keys for referring to that data (book identification numbers, user numbers, and so on) are in principle kept as the current ones.
patches.to: If an existing file (table) is to be used as-is after migration, the numbering scheme that serves as its key (book identification numbers and user numbers) is not changed.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: the work, risk, and cost of data migration and conversion rise sharply. In designing a migration approach, the key point is to think separately about what changes (here, the reading medium) and what does not change (here, the numbering scheme).
patches.to: migration cost and risk rise sharply.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp「移行コストとリスクが跳ね上がる」、変わるもの/変わらないもの を削除)

patches.from: RFID是用电波以非接触方式读写信息的机制，与条形码不同，它可以一次批量读取多个标签，也可以隔着遮挡物读取，因此能提高图书馆借还书和藏书清点的效率。不过RFID只是识别的手段（介质）变了，写入其中的识别号本身完全可以与既有的条形码取相同的值。
patches.to: RFID是取代条形码的自动识别介质，即使更换介质，其中的识别号也可以沿用。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い RFID の説明を削除、jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: 在新旧介质并用的并行迁移中，让同一对象始终以同一号码被识别，是不停止业务完成迁移的关键。
patches.to: 在新旧介质并用、逐步更换的迁移中，为了不停止业务，保持号码体系的连续性是常规做法。
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 2 文「定石」)

patches.from: RFID is a mechanism that reads and writes information wirelessly without contact. Unlike a barcode, it can read many tags at once and can read through obstacles, so it can make library lending, returning, and stocktaking more efficient. However, with RFID only the means (the medium) of identification changes; the identification number written into it can be the very same value as the existing barcode.
patches.to: RFID is an automatic identification medium that replaces barcodes, and even when the medium is swapped, the identification number inside can be carried over.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp に無い RFID の説明を削除、jp 第 1 文)

patches.from: In a parallel migration that uses old and new media together, making sure the same object is identified by the same number is the key to migrating without halting operations.
patches.to: In a migration that gradually swaps media while using the old and new together, keeping the numbering scheme continuous so as not to halt operations is the standard practice.
patches.target_note: S110 Rule A low: 系統的増量の削除 / jp 欠落文の補充 (jp 第 2 文「定石」)
